key.name: enabled
key.summary: Show a video on the screensaver and lock screen

key.name: video-uri
key.description: URI (or absolute path) of the video to play. Empty means use the wallpaper.

key.name: scaling
key.summary: How the video is fitted to the monitor

key.name: dim
key.summary: How much to darken the video (0 = not at all, 1 = black)

key.name: pause-on-battery
key.summary: Show a still frame instead of playing while on battery

key.name: pause-when-screen-off
key.summary: Pause decoding while the monitors are powered down
